Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 10, 2026

Cornerstone Services, Inc. ("Company," "CRST," "we," "our," "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website, https://crst.net (the "Site"), and use our services. By accessing or using our Site and services, you agree to the terms outlined in this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect

We collect personal and non-personal information from you through various methods:

A. Personal Information

We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide, including but not limited to:

  • Contact Information: names, mailing addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, social media accounts and credit worthiness.
  • Payment Information: credit card or other payment details, via third-party secure applications, necessary only to process transactions securely between you and us. CRST only facilitates payment transactions and does not directly collect credit card, wire transfer, bank account or similar financially sensitive payment details.

B. Automatically Collected Information

When you interact with our website, we may automatically collect:

  • Log and Usage Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages viewed, and access times.
  • Device Information: device type, settings, and unique identifiers.

C. Information From Third Parties

We may collect information about you from third-party services, public sources or trusted partners that integrate with our services.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information collected for purposes including, but not limited to:

  • Providing, operating, and maintaining our services;
  • Improving, personalizing, communicating and expanding our offerings;
  • Analyzing usage patterns to enhance user experience;
  • Processing transactions and managing customer orders;
  • Sending updates, promotional content, and service-related communications;
  • Preventing fraudulent transactions and ensuring security; and
  • Complying with legal obligations and resolving disputes.

Sharing Your Information

We do not sell or trade your personal information. However, we may share your data under the following circumstances:

  • Service Providers: with trusted third-party service providers who provide assistance towards operating our website and services.
  • Business Transfers: in the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your data may be transferred to the new entity.
  • Legal Compliance: when required by law or in response to a valid legal request from authorities.

Data Security

The Company has in place industry-standard security measures to protect the privacy of your personal information. However, CRST does operate in a cloud server environment, and no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure; therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Cookies & Analytics

Our website uses Google Analytics (GA4) to understand how visitors use our site. This service uses cookies to collect anonymous usage data. You can opt out of Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

Mailing List Data

Client mailing list data provided to us for campaign purposes is treated as confidential. We do not use client mailing lists for any purpose other than the authorized campaign. Lists are retained only as long as needed for the project unless otherwise agreed.

SMS/Text Messaging Consent & Policy

By providing your phone number and opting in to receive text messages from Cornerstone Services, Inc., you consent to receive SMS/MMS messages related to your inquiry, project updates, appointment reminders, and service-related communications. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies.

  • Opt-Out: You may opt out of receiving text messages at any time by replying STOP to any message you receive from us. After opting out, you will receive a one-time confirmation message and no further texts will be sent.
  • Help: Reply HELP to any message for assistance, or contact us at info@crst.net or (845) 255-5722.
  • No Mobile Information Sharing: We do not sell, rent, loan, trade, lease, or otherwise transfer for profit any phone numbers or personal information collected through our SMS program to any third party.
  • Carriers: Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of purchasing any goods or services from Cornerstone Services, Inc.. This SMS policy is compliant with CTIA guidelines, TCPA regulations, and A2P 10DLC messaging requirements.

Your Rights and Choices

You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • Access, Update & Delete: request access to, correction or deletion of your own specific contact or profile information wherein (a) you specifically and voluntarily provided such information to us, or (b) your information is easily identifiable by us and may be accessed, updated and/or deleted in accordance to reasonable requests.
  • Opt-Out: unsubscribe from promotional emails or be removed from promotional mailings at any time.
  • Restrict Handling or Processing: request limitations on how your contact information is held and/or processed.

To exercise these rights, contact us using the information below, preferably via email to avoid any confusion about your requests.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page, and we encourage you to review it regularly.

Children's Privacy

Our website and services are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover that we have inadvertently collected such data, we will take steps to delete it promptly.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

  • Address: 31 South Ohioville Road, New Paltz, NY 12561
  • Phone: (845) 255-5722
  • Email: info@crst.net

By using our website and services, you acknowledge and consent to this Privacy Policy.
